args.title: Fix CSV parsing to handle quoted header fields correctly
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The current CSV parsing logic for the header line does not handle quoted fields correctly. Modify the existing parsing logic in `parseStatement` to manage quoted header fields properly and ensure the first row is handled exactly like any other data row.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is caused by incorrect handling of quoted header fields in the CSV parsing logic. The header line is split without considering quoted commas. The proposed fix modifies the logic to correctly parse quoted header fields.
